columns.label: Notable Weapons
columns.comment: exemplary weapons that showcase origin trait effects

tierLegend.text: game-warping, extreme utility, or BiS damage boosts
downgrades or strong but more weapon, build, or context-dependent
less noticeable ability gains, niche utility, worst refill effects
best reload buffs, enemy-specific damage, very specialized benefits
mediocre reload buffs and decent QoL stats
technically positive but almost no effect

records.name: Timelost Magazine
records.effect:
1?% super
refill, 2x mag for 21s, stowable
records.description: almopst singlehandedly enables the strongest rocket damage strategy, solid neutral as well

comments.trigger: Izanagi's Burden, Jötunn, Le Monarque also count

records.name: Forge's Kin
records.trigger: Black Armory weapon kill or readying Black Armory weapon within 7s of weapon kill with Black Armory* weapons equipped (3 stacks)
records.effect: 15-? reload, ?-? ammo gen, 0-13% damage for 5-9s
records.description: highest sustained damage buff from an origin trait

records.name: Accelerated Assault
records.trigger: 3 damage instances within 1.2s of each, 0.8s minimum to count next hit
records.effect: 10% refill (no refill and ?s reload for 8s instead on 1 mag weapons), 6% damage for 4s, 4s extensions on damage (2s if <2s), stowable
records.description: pseudo-Rewind Rounds + basically permanent 6% damage buff

records.name: Subjugation
records.effect:
explosive shots, 3?m splash (every 4 hits for trace)
exhaust for 5s
records.description: stronger Explosive Payload + instant exhaust on-hit, insane versatility

records.name: Land Tank
records.effect: 10 Health, 5?% DR per stack for 5s, stowable
records.description: highest sustainable DR from an origin trait

records.name: Heretical Behavior
records.trigger: 4 hits (glaive melee/support auto healing require 8) within 3s of each, 0.4s minimum to count next hit
records.effect: 8% damage, 50? handling, 50? reload, 0.8x? reload duration for 10s, 26s duration when being revived, refreshable to highest duration
records.description: higher damage than Accelerated Assault, instead of Rewind has QoL stat buffs

comments.trigger: Ace of Spades, Khvostov 7G-0X, Ergo Sum, Still Hunt, and Microcosm also count

records.name: Dealer's Choice
records.trigger: weapon kill with Dealer's Choice* weapons equipped (3 stacks)
records.description: part of the fastest solo super generating method in the game

records.name: Souldrinker
records.effect: 55 HP for every 100% of mag hit (GLs have halved progress, glaive melees don't count), stowable
records.description: highest healing uptime from an origin trait

records.name: Tenacity
records.trigger: weapon kill within 15m of enemy (20 stacks)
records.effect: up to 10% damage, 55? handling, 55? reload at max stacks
records.description: outside of kill requirement, no special conditions for free 10% damage buff and solid stat buffs

records.name: Veteran's Wisdom
records.trigger: crit kill or 3 weapon kills within 3s of each
records.effect: 20? damage kinetic 10s exhausting 9m shockwave
records.description: insane uptime on exhaust spread, especially on crit-friendly weapons

records.name: Nano-Munitions
records.effect: (25?% * stacks) rounded up refill when mag empties, readying power weapon forcefully consumes all stacks
records.description: not on any good weapons but would be pretty great on relevant DPS weapons

records.name: Contending Cascade
records.effect: up to ? handling, ? reload, 100-260 damage 7m explosion on kill
records.description: unfortunately not many weapons to showcase, would be really good on meta archetypes

records.name: Carrion Munitions
records.effect: 600-950 damage 25m seeking 5m radius weapon-matched drone
records.description: arguably strongest or most practical splash effect given seeking nature and high damage

records.name: Dark Ether Reaper
records.trigger:
4? minors or 1 elite+ weapon kills
shooting ether charge
records.effect:
386 damage shootable/walkable 3m weapon-coded ether charge
refill, 40% overflow rounded up

records.name: Cursed Thrall
records.trigger: weapon kill within 8.5?s of melee kill
records.effect: 123.5 damage 4.5m explosion
records.description: very high uptime splash effect if on the right build

records.name: Cast No Shadows
records.effect: ? handling for ?s, 20% refill
records.description: bypasses grapple melee restriction on Grave Robber, allows for double perk 12P shotguns

records.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
records.trigger: variable mag% hit (1.5-2?s ICD after missile fired)
records.effect: weapon-matched tracking 46.4 missile
records.description: ~3-6% effective damage increase but completely passive

records.trigger: ADS or block within 1s of taking damage
records.effect: 5% damage, 30 mobility, 40 handling, 35 charge rate for 7.5?s, not refreshable, stowable
records.description: relatively easy-to-access 5% damage buff for damage-realistic window

records.name: Bray Legacy
records.effect: 0.19-17% most-charged ability (except multi-charge abilities)
records.description: strongest ability chunk gains from an origin trait, especially for on-hit scenarios

records.name: Ambush
records.trigger: entering combat after being out of combat for 5s

records.description: very sensitive activation conditions, pretty solid damage increase on first contact though

records.name: Skulking Wolf
records.effect: enhanced radar, Amplified enemy accuracy drop, no passive enemy radar pings for 11s, stowable
records.description: Amplified effect on non-Amplified subclasses is nice

records.name: Problem Solver

records.effect: exhaust for 5s, 50? reload, 50? handling for 12.5s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: more restricted enemy classes than Psychohack but offers stat buffs

records.name: Psychohack
records.trigger: variable # of hits within 3s of each
records.effect: exhaust for ?s
records.description: worse than Subjugation in every way but still free exhaust on any target

records.name: Extrovert
records.trigger: 0.25s after weapon (glaive melee counts) kill within 15m of 3 enemies or Nightmare (3s ICD)
records.effect: 60? HP
records.description: free chip healing even if 3s ICD isn't the greatest

records.effect:
? stability, ? reload, ?% flinch resist
45? ammo gen for 3s, refreshable by sprint

records.name: Frame of Reference
records.effect: 1.45/2.8/4.2/5.6/7% damage, ?-? range, ?-? reload for 8s, refreshable, paused while stowed
records.description: permanently active 7% damage increase during roam, short-term burst during damage is an option as well

records.name: Fail-deadly
records.effect: up to 2x mag, 15? range, 5? AA at max stacks, stacks removed on kill, stowable
records.description: like Timelost Magazine but doesn't refill on super cast, and isn't initially active without prep, but doesn't require super

records.name: Radiolaria Transposer
records.trigger: 3 minors or 1+ elite kill within 8s of each, counter resets on stow
records.effect: 67.5 damage 3m explosion, 15 arc damage every 0.65s over ?m from pool for ?s
records.description: splash isn't that strong and counter requirement worse than top-tier splash traits, still fairly potent though

records.name: Eyes Up
records.effect: ? range, ? reload, 1.5-5% damage for 8s, 4s extensions up to 25s, stowable
records.description: like Tenacity but worse numbers and tied to duration, still decent though

records.name: Gravity Well
records.effect: picks up ammo, motes, and crests within 15m
records.description: 15m pretty solid radius for picking up ammo and other listed items

records.name: Runneth Over
records.effect: up to 50?% overflow, 0.75x draw, ? charge rate
records.description: surprisingly not that good given manual reload requirement, would be like free Clown Cartridge on rockets or special GLs

records.name: Bray Inheritance
records.effect: 0.35-2% all abilities
records.description: good passive ability energy gains but less direct and intentional compared to Legacy

records.name: Indomitability
records.trigger:
weapon kill with light super equipped
weapon kill with dark super equipped
records.effect:
6?% grenade
6?% melee
records.description: like having a 27% stronger Demolitionist/Pugilist

records.name: Stunning Recovery
records.effect: refill, 60 HP, health regen
records.description: pretty solid QoL for champion content

records.name: Exhaustive Research
records.trigger: ADS for 0.6s near enemy within 60m (5.5s ICD)
records.effect: first shot becomes 450-800 damage 3m micro-missile
records.description: ICD and ADS time requirement make this a little subpar but missile damage output is actually decent and procs perks like 12P

records.name: Tex Balanced Stock

records.name: Dream Work
records.trigger: assist or kill on ally-damaged enemy, once per reload
records.effect: 66% refill, ? reload and 0.?x draw for ?s, can overflow and trigger while stowed

records.name: Vanguard Determination

records.effect: 2/4/6% DR for 12.5s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: very low DR but very easy to gain and maintain

records.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
records.effect: 20% vehicle damage, 35% turret/construct damage, 45?% crystal damage
records.description: situational damage boosts but covers three different possibilities, with one being build-based

34.3% elemental/barrier shield damage, 21.6?% overshield damage
disorient for 5s (?m burst for ?s if matching)
records.description: pseudo-Under-Over + Shield Disorient is actually pretty decent, even given typical shielded enemy frequency

records.name: Restoration Ritual
records.effect:
refill and refills mag on next depletion
5 handling
records.description: basically just used for overflowing single mag weapons, one-time nature makes this not as appealing

records.name: Veist Stinger

full mag or heat <10?%
sprinting for 0.5s

? handling, -?% ADS movespeed penalty
? reload for 6?s

records.name: Alacrity

1 ally dead

10 range, 10 stability, 25 reload, 5 AA
